N6-FLOOR.description: U6-L1: Gate 5's level comparison is neutralised — the RETURN VALUE of the shadowing check is replaced, never a line deleted (§0.5 E-INDEP). A TOOL ref and an unregistered C9 key both derive STEP_UP_VERIFIED (K4 fail-closed), which a pwa session cannot meet, so on a conformant build they stop at slot 5 and never reach Gate 6. With this set they reach it, and S-TOOL / S-REG read Gate 6's own DETAIL.
